description: This file defines cache provider interfaces and implementations for Mattermost, including in-memory LRU cache and Redis cache, with methods for creating, connecting, and managing cache instances.

classes.name: cacheProvider
classes.description: Implements the Provider interface for in-memory LRU cache.

classes.name: redisProvider
classes.description: Implements the Provider interface for Redis cache.

methods.name: NewProvider
methods.description: Creates a new in-memory cache provider.

methods.name: NewCache
methods.description: Creates a new cache instance based on options.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the cache backend.

methods.name: SetMetrics
methods.description: Sets metrics interface for cache provider.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Releases resources used by the cache provider.

methods.name: NewRedisProvider
methods.description: Creates a new Redis cache provider.
